item.title: The average mobile phone camera roll has the faces of 350 strangers
item.description: The average mobile phone camera roll has the faces of 350 strangers thanks to accidental photobombing by passers-by, tourists and random faces in the background.

item.title: Budapest Design Week shines a spotlight on the city’s culture
item.description: Sitting on the red-carpeted central steps of the Hungarian State Opera House, we watched a prima donna perform just inches away, framed by gilded fin-de-siècle grandeur. This was one moment of many where cheap drinks and stag do crowds felt a world away in this sophisticated Central European city, writes Emma Cooke.
